body.name: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{CiC}}^{\mathrm{per}}\)
body.def:
The torus changes-in-changes causal class of four observed laws admitting latent laws \(
u_C,
u_T\) and invertible production maps \(h_0,h_1,h_{1\star}\) with \(P_{C0}=h_0\#
u_C\), \(P_{C1}=h_1\#
u_C\), \(P_{T0}=h_0\#
u_T\), \(P_{T1}=h_{1\star}\#
u_T\), and with the graphs of \(h_1\circ h_0^{-1}\) and \(h_1\circ h_{1\star}^{-1}\) both \(c_{\mathbb T}\)-cyclically monotone.
